skill.name: connect-google-ads
skill.description: Connect Google Ads and its linked Merchant Center to Product Metrics using the Product Metrics CLI or MCP server. Use Google sign-in or a read-only manager invite, then verify the connection status.
skill.summary: Connect Google Ads and Merchant Center to Product Metrics and diagnose connection issues.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The backticks are Markdown, the URLs point to vendor documentation, and the identity and account queries are scoped to Product Metrics setup. One CLI example does not specify safe shell argument handling for a store name. The workflow also lacks consistent approval before writes, consent link validation, and clear rules for redacting errors.

remediation.issue: The account creation example inserts a free-form store name into a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Pass validated IDs and store names as separate arguments without shell parsing, or use the matching MCP operation with structured inputs.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not consistently confirm the target workspace, account, and requested change before writes.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the workspace, account IDs, and exact operation before sending invites, creating connections, or requesting conversion setup. Explain the access granted by the manager invite.

remediation.issue: The browser step forwards a sign-in link without checking its destination.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and verify the destination against documented Product Metrics or Google origins before sharing the link. Provide a known dashboard route if validation fails.

remediation.issue: The reporting instructions request verbatim service errors without broader redaction rules.
remediation.suggestion: Summarize errors and share only the request ID needed for support. Remove credentials, private links, and account data that the user does not need.

content.user_title: Connect Google Ads to Product Metrics
content.value_statement: Google Ads reporting in Product Metrics requires the right account and permissions. Connect the client account and its linked Merchant Center, then see what still needs attention.
actual_capabilities: Check the signed-in Product Metrics identity, Google grant, and existing workspace connections.
List accessible Google Ads accounts and create a property for the selected client account through Google sign-in.
Send a manager invite and create a read-only connection after the account owner accepts it.
Link an already associated Merchant Center account and show the setup plan for review.
Recheck an existing connection after an error, invite acceptance, or renewed sign-in.
Read conversion action status without making an action primary.
limitations: Requires the Product Metrics CLI or MCP server and administrator access for some workspace operations.
The user must grant Google access or accept the manager invite in a browser.
The Merchant Center account must already be linked to the selected Google Ads account within Google.
The advertiser must select primary conversion actions and bidding goals in Google Ads.

use_cases.title: Set Up Your First Ads Connection
use_cases.description: Check Google access and connect the client account that runs your store's campaigns.

use_cases.title: Connect a Client Through a Manager Invite
use_cases.description: Send a read-only manager invite and finish the Product Metrics connection after the client accepts it.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Reporting Interruption
use_cases.description: Check a revoked or failed connection and verify whether renewed access restored the property.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Identify missing access without changing anything.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Google Ads setup in [workspace]. Tell me whether Google access is missing and which accounts are already connected. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Connect Through Google Sign-In
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Add a client account using your existing Google access.
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Google Ads client accounts I can access for [workspace]. Ask me to confirm the workspace and client account before creating a property.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up a Read-Only Manager Link
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Connect an account that your Google sign-in cannot reach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify [workspace] and [customer ID] with me before sending a read-only manager invite. Wait for me to accept it before creating the connection.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Merchant Center and Conversions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Review the linked merchant and conversion status before making changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recheck [property] and read its conversion action status. Confirm the merchant ID with me before linking it. Show any reuse plan and wait for approval.

output_examples.input: Check whether my store account is connected.
output_examples.output: Example Store Ads, customer ID 123-456-7890, is connected to the Example Store property. The connection is active. Merchant Center setup is still pending.

output_examples.input: Check the status of my manager invite.
output_examples.output: The manager invite for customer ID 123-456-7890 is pending. Accept it under Managers in Google Ads. The Product Metrics property has not been created.

output_examples.input: Review my Merchant Center setup plan.
output_examples.output: The setup plan proposes reusing the existing Store Products source. Confirm the source before applying the plan. No setup changes have been applied.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace, client account, merchant ID, and requested change before making any connection changes.
Complete consent and invite acceptance yourself on a verified Product Metrics or Google page.
Review the Merchant Center plan and verify the final connection status after any approved change.
anti_patterns: Select a manager account instead of the client account that runs the campaigns.
Share passwords, access tokens, or private consent links in chat.
Delete a failing connection before rechecking access, or apply a Merchant Center plan without approval.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: Use an installed Product Metrics CLI or a configured Product Metrics MCP server. Some connection operations require a workspace administrator.

faq.question: Which connection method should I choose?
faq.answer: Use Google sign-in if it reaches the client account. Otherwise, a read-only manager invite lets the account owner approve the link.

faq.question: Can I connect a Google Ads manager account?
faq.answer: No. Select the client account that runs the campaigns. A manager may provide login context for that client account.

faq.question: What do a 403 or 409 mean?
faq.answer: A 403 on an admin operation means you need an administrator. A 409 can indicate an invite conflict or a missing Merchant Center association.

faq.question: Can this skill link an unrelated Merchant Center account?
faq.answer: No. Google must already associate the Merchant Center account with your selected Ads account before Product Metrics can link it.

faq.question: Will the skill change my bidding goals?
faq.answer: No. It can read conversion settings. The advertiser chooses primary actions and campaign goals in Google Ads.
